title: Grounding Knowledge — A1 to B1
description: Práctica comunicativa progresiva de A1 a B1. Rutinas, preferencias, experiencias y opiniones para consolidar el speaking.
topic: Speaking review · A1 → B1 · Communicative approach

questions.question: What's your name and where are you from?
How old are you and where do you live?
What time do you usually wake up?
What do you usually have for breakfast?
How many people are there in your family?
Do you live with your family?
What's your favorite food?
What kind of music do you like?
What do you usually do on weekends?
Do you play any sports? Which ones?
What do you do — do you work or study?
Do you like your job (or what you study)? Why?
How often do you exercise?
What's your favorite color, and why?
What's your favorite movie or TV show?
How do you usually spend your evenings?
Who are you closest to in your family? Why?
Do you prefer coffee or tea? Why?
Have you ever traveled to another country? Tell me about it.
Do you prefer the beach or the mountains? Why?
What did you do last weekend?
What kind of books do you enjoy reading?
What's the most difficult part of your job (or your studies)?
What's the best trip you've ever taken?
Describe your best friend. What are they like?
Have you ever tried a food that really surprised you?
Do you cook? What's your favorite dish to make?
What's your favorite way to relax after a long day?
Which country would you like to visit one day, and why?
Have you ever done something you never thought you'd do?
How do you usually celebrate your birthday?
What did you want to be when you were a child?
How often do you eat out during the week?
What do you think about social media? Is it more helpful or harmful?
Tell me about a time you were really nervous. What happened?
Do you think technology has made our lives better or worse? Why?
If you could live anywhere in the world, where would it be, and why?
Is it better to live in a big city or a small town? Explain your view.
Where do you see yourself in five years?
What's the most important lesson life has taught you so far?
How do you feel about working or studying from home?
If you won the lottery tomorrow, what's the first thing you'd do?
In your opinion, what's the biggest challenge for young people today?
Describe a moment that changed the way you see the world.
What would you change about your city or your country?
Should schools focus more on languages, sciences, or arts? Why?
Talk about a person who has really influenced your life.
What are the pros and cons of online shopping?
If you could learn any skill instantly, what would it be, and why?
Describe a book, movie or series that really impacted you, and explain why.
